verdict.rationale: cubic's CLI runs AI code review on local uncommitted changes (`cubic review`), but it does not act as a coding agent. It finds bugs and generates a prompt for a separate coding agent to apply the fixes. Its fix-generating capability ('Fix with cubic') runs on PR branches, not as a local terminal agent. A local review CLI is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal
